sources.title: mlboydaisuke/Qwen3-VL-4B-CoreAI · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3-VL 4B — Core AI (.aimodel) Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct converted to Apple Core AI (.aimodel, iOS 27 / macOS 27): image+text → text fully on the GPU via Apple's coreai-pipelined engine, zero custom kernels. The 4B sibling of the Qwen3-VL 2B port — it drops onto the same recipe with zero code changes (the model overlay and exporter are fully config-driven).

sources.title: executorch/examples/models/qwen3/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen 3 is the latest iteration of the Qwen series of large language models (LLMs) developed by Alibaba. Edge-sized Qwen3 model variations (0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B) are currently supported .
